entities.name: Query SUS1 protein
observations: 97 aa protein sequence exactly matches reviewed UniProt A5DG59 from Meyerozyma guilliermondii; identity and coverage are 100%.
Contains Pfam EnY2 domain PF10163.15 at residues 10–92.
Predicted molecular weight is 11.52 kDa and theoretical pI is 4.73; sequence is acidic with estimated charge −6.39 at pH 7.
Curated SUS1 function is participation in TREX-2 and SAGA complexes, coupling RNA polymerase II transcription with mRNA export.

entities.name: A5DG59 SUS1
observations: Reviewed UniProt protein from Meyerozyma guilliermondii; exact sequence match to the query.
SUS1 is a component of TREX-2 and the SAGA DUB module; it supports transcription coactivation, RNA polymerase II transcription, and nuclear mRNA export.
TREX-2 contains two SUS1 chains according to the curated subunit annotation.
